_comment: Anchor table for generated held-item sheets (scripts/make_held_sheet.py).
All numbers MEASURED from real Kaetram sheets (48x48 frames, 4x9).
Model (from lolipop/balloon/spoon/ironsword): the art mass sits at HAND
height (~y23-26) and only a thin handle/stick reaches down to the grip
at y~32; idle_down items overlap the shoulder rows (authentic Kaetram).
centre12 = absolute (cx, cy) of the 12x12 art-block centre per column.
rot = per-frame art rotation (Kaetram REDRAWS swing poses; atk_right f1
is a raised windup, f2 the horizontal slash + streak, f3 follow-through).
atk_down f2/f3 = overhead smash landing low in front (y~35).
atk_up f2/f3 are EMPTY in the real sheets.
Left facing reuses *_right with flipX (client-side, existing).
